body.heading: Where in the world is Brunei?
paragraphs: Brunei is a country in Southeast Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Brunei is Bandar Seri Begawan.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Brunei is Malay.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Brunei is the Brunei dollar.

body.heading: How big is Brunei?
paragraphs: Brunei covers about 6,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Qatar.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Most of Brunei is rainforest, and Ulu Temburong is its jewel — longboat rides up the river lead to a canopy walkway high in untouched jungle.
Kampong Ayer is a whole town on stilts over the Brunei River — schools, mosques and thousands of homes linked by wooden walkways, reached by water taxi.
